reason: My doctor said my magnesium could be low, so this is a real problem for me, and the named lab report plus the empty-box refund make it feel safe to try once at $24.99. I would buy one box and see how I feel.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? And $30 a month is more than I pay for bigger bottles of bisglycinate at the store.
would_change_my_mind: If it stayed at $29.99 with no launch price, or if the lab report was not actually there when I scan the QR code, I would skip it.
